authority: Owner approved implementation of the proposed runnable-software and paper upgrade; explicitly selected 200 JLA probes and unchanged backend/solver routing.

contract.q0: Each target requires its own finite positive scalar variance and applicable numerical checks.
contract.q1: Retain leading certification, positive leading and remainder variances, determinant, remainder identity and interval-construction checks; scalar positivity alone is insufficient.
contract.joint: Never export a materially invalid joint matrix as an admissible covariance. e(V) is only available for q0 with admissible joint covariance; q1 uses its specialized target intervals.
contract.failures: Shared identification, variance-fit, solver, resource and corrupted-result failures remain fatal. Local failures preserve other computed intervals. No material PSD clipping, hidden regularization or estimator fallback.
contract.ordering: Design-only canonical ordering with explicit identical-design-row handling; ordinary use requires no new user key. Preserve original explicit-key research attachment semantics.
contract.compatibility: Add versioned native interfaces; retain strict frozen legacy entrypoints and immutable historical receipts. Changed numerical ordering must satisfy registered statistical-equivalence gates, not a fabricated bitwise-identity claim.

validation.development: Independent dense tests; recorded-setting replay of audited failures; prospective complete 48-cell small development profile at 200 JLA probes; public Stata/native parity and deliberate harness failures before confirmation.
validation.confirmation: Separately freeze exact source, seeds, task inventory and inherited family-specific thresholds before fresh confirmation: 20 observation cells and 14 cells each for match q0/q1, 2500 replications each, 120000 native calls; local, at most eight workers.
validation.stop: A material development failure blocks confirmation. A frozen confirmation failure blocks promotion. Do not increase the 200-probe default, weaken gates, relabel designs or retry scientific confirmation without a new owner decision.

delivery: Qualify candidate and update companion paper only to the resulting evidence. Complete native payload and exact-artifact checks remain required; Windows collection infrastructure requires its existing separate authorization and verified shutdown.
